title: LearnOps lesson manifest (B6, v1)
description: The lesson.json manifest in a lesson folder (PRD B6.2, B6.3). It lists the lesson's tracks and derived files. Every path is relative to the lesson folder (PRD B6.3, C-08). This schema checks structure only; rules that need the lesson folder or the configuration are listed under $comment and are enforced by validator code, not by this file.
$comment: Unknown fields are allowed on purpose: after Release 0 contracts change only by adding optional fields and readers ignore unknown fields (PRD B.0, EXT-02). Required (guide decision, PRD B6.3): schema, course_slug, lesson_id, title, duration_s, and the fields that point to files B6.2 marks as required (tracks with exactly one main track, captions, transcript, chapters). Optional: slides, cues, summary, source, processing. Track roles are open lowercase names so new kinds of track need no contract change; main, main-low, camera and screen are the known ones and a v1 reader ignores roles it doesn't play. poster.jpg is required by B6.2 but has no manifest field: readers find it by its fixed file name in the lesson folder. transcript only names the file; its contents follow the B5.4 transcript shape, which this schema does not repeat. NOT expressible in JSON Schema, so NOT enforced here: that the named files exist in the lesson folder; that lesson.json is written last, only when every required file exists (FR-V-08); that lesson_id and course_slug match the folder's place in the B6.1 path template (the template is configurable); the file names B6.2 gives (720p.mp4, captions.en.vtt and so on), since the manifest is what readers follow. processing.completed_at: the pattern guarantees the RFC 3339 shape and field ranges (month 01-12, day 01-31, hour 00-23 and so on) with any validator; calendar validity (for example no 31 February) is checked only by a validator run with a date-time format checker, which jsonschema provides only when the rfc3339-validator package is installed (it is not in requirements-dev.txt).

course_slug.description: The course slug used in the lesson's path (PRD B6.1, B1.1).

lesson_id.description: The lesson's place below the course folder, for example 01-setup/02-install-python (PRD B6.3). Its form follows the configurable path template (B6.1), so this schema does not fix it.

duration_s.description: Length of the lesson in seconds.

tracks.description: Every video track of the lesson. Exactly one main track (PRD B6.2: 720p.mp4), so a reader never has to choose between two. Other tracks are optional. camera and screen are reserved for F-1 and are listed, not played, in v1 (PRD B6.2, B6.3); a v1 reader ignores roles it doesn't play.

captions.description: WebVTT caption files (PRD B6.2: captions.en.vtt is required).

transcript.description: Path to the transcript file: segments with word timings in the B5.4 transcript shape (PRD B6.2). Only the path is checked here; the file's contents belong to the B5 contract.

slides.description: Slide-change index [{t, thumb, text?}] (PRD B6.2; optional, feature flag).

cues.description: Moments where an activity should appear [{t, type, ref, label}] (PRD B6.2; optional).

summary.description: Short summary in Markdown (PRD B6.2; optional, feature flag).

slug.description: Lowercase ASCII letters and digits separated by single hyphens (PRD B6.1, B1.1). Also the form of track roles. The end anchor is (?![\s\S]) instead of $ because Python's $ also matches before a trailing newline.

relative_path.description: Path relative to the lesson folder, with forward slashes. Not a URL, not absolute, no '..' segment (PRD B6.3, C-08).

role.description: Open list of lowercase names in the slug form, so a new kind of track (for example audio) needs no contract change. Known roles: main: the main video (720p). main-low: the low-bandwidth copy (360p, optional). camera, screen: separate tracks reserved for F-1 (PRD B6.2, B6.3).

height.description: Frame height in pixels, for example 720 or 360.

kind.description: Where the lesson came from. The PRD names only upload (B6.3); BigBlueButton intake (FR-V-09) is another source whose value the PRD does not name, so this is not an enum.

uploaded_by.description: The uploader's LTI sub (PRD B6.3, B3). No other personal data.

original_name.description: File name of the uploaded original.

pipeline_version.description: Version of the pipeline that produced the lesson; a re-process records a new one (FR-V-11).

completed_at.description: When processing finished, as an RFC 3339 timestamp with a time zone.
